scene.language: Here, this represents a checking scenario. There's an opponent, a coach, and a teammate. So the opponent can play defense either tight or loose, and in this case, the opponent is more... Is playing not as tight defense, and they're farther away from the coach. So the coach will make, will check at an angle to receive the ball from the teammate. (ball thudding)[0][1] Notice the coach has checked at an angle and now is open for a pass from the teammate. [2][3][4](ball thudding) Now, notice that the opponent is still pretty far from the coach, so the coach has space to move forward and dribble. There's no need to pass it back to the teammate. [5][6](ball thudding)
